# BTC treasury packets

`propamm-143.json` is the existing mock RFQ buy packet from PropAMM PR #143.

`propamm-156-sell.json` is generated by `server/src/btc_treasury.rs::trade_instructions`
on PropAMM's `btc-treasury-sells` branch, using the Velox primeBTC/aBTC market and
its treasury minter. It pays 1,000,000 primeBTC atoms into that market's base vault
and mints 1,005,000 aBTC atoms to the minter before paying the user. The request ID
is 32 bytes of `0x55` and the blockhash is 32 bytes of `0x01`. The user is copied
from the existing inventory-sell fixture. This is an unsigned builder fixture,
not an executable live quote; tests supply a current response expiry.
